chapters.label: The final
chapters.text: Munich, 1988, the Euro final. The Netherlands, in orange, lead the Soviet Union one-nil. Arnold Mühren floats a long cross from the left, and van Basten volleys it. Goal!

chapters.label: Watch again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. He watches the ball all the way. He gets over it and strikes first time, with his right foot.

chapters.label: Over the keeper
chapters.text: From that tight angle, it loops over Dasayev into the far corner. Two-nil! The Netherlands are champions of Europe!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Eyes on the ball, body over it, strike cleanly through it. With perfect technique, even hard angles can work.
